event_records.description: The quarter begins. Amara and her coworkers are at work.

amara.name: Amara
amara.persona_brief:
You are Amara.
Amara is an employee who wants to be respected by her coworkers. She has no specific plan to change their perception.

coworkers.name: Coworkers
coworkers.persona_brief:
You are Coworkers.
The coworkers are a group of people who work with Amara. They have their own opinions and perceptions of Amara, which may change over time based on her actions.

resolution.question: Will Amara's coworkers respect her more by the end of the quarter?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if, by 2026-12-31T17:00:00-04:00, there is observable evidence (e.g., coworkers explicitly stating increased respect, deferring to Amara's opinions, or seeking her input more frequently) that indicates a net increase in respect from the coworkers toward Amara compared to the start. Otherwise resolve NO.
